newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone head seeks higher chemicals profit.
newsitem.headline: Rhone head seeks higher chemicals profit.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc president Jean-Rene Fourtou told a newspaper on Monday he was giving himself two years to raise the profitability of the company's chemicals activity to the level of its health and agriculture business.

"Our objective is very clearly that chemicals overall ... should become a sector as profitable as life sciences (health and agriculture) and that its business should show significant growth. I give myself two years to succeed," Fourtou said in an interview with Le Figaro daily.
Fourtou said the company already saw signs that its policies were succeeding since the operating results of its chemicals business grew very strongly last year.
Operating income from chemicals more than trebled to 941 million francs in 1996 from 278 million in 1995, the company reported on January 30.
Fourtou also said Rhone-Poulenc needed to increase its polyester business in Europe and look for partners.
